Fictional practice document — Escuela Horizonte
Spanish B1 course in Granada. Classes take place on Tuesdays and Thursdays, 18:00–19:30.
The course lasts eight weeks and costs 240 euros. There are at most ten students.
The cancellation policy and whether materials are included are not specified.

course.Spanish:
Fictional practice document — Escuela Horizonte
Curso de español B1 en Granada. Las clases son los martes y jueves, de 18:00 a 19:30.
El curso dura ocho semanas y cuesta 240 euros. Hay un máximo de diez estudiantes.
No se especifican la política de cancelación ni los materiales incluidos.
